3)Do Export the configuration
4)Try to import Exported configuration
4.title: Import Export works with DHCP Option Objects/Groups
4.description: This test is to make sure import/Export works with DHCP Generic option configuration.
4.result: Configuration imported/exported properly. Shows DHCP option settings preserved.

6.steps:
1)Configure DHCP option object for Tag No, say: 230.
2)Force a DHCP client to request for option 230. in the DHCP Discover/Request packet, in the Option55 parameter list add option 230 two times.
6.title: DHCP Server doesnt insert same option tag multiple times  for DHCP option request send by the client.
6.description: This test ensures that same option Tag is not repeated in the DHCP OFFER/ACK message. (Note: Provided same option is not configured in the basic configuration of DHCP address pool, ex: DNS, Domain Name, Router address etc)
6.result: The DHCP server OFFER/ACK packet should show only one DHCP option with Tag Number 230.

7.steps:
1)Configure following DHCP option Objects option1: TagNo 230, value = 10.10.10.10, option2: TagNo = 231, value = 11.11.11.11.
2)Create an option Group: optionGrp12 with option1 and option2 as members.
3)Bind DHCP Generic group handle with optionGrp12 in the DHCP server configuration.
4)Start a DHCP client to do a Discover.
5)The client got an IP address from the pool.
6)Now Delete option object option1.
7.title: Removing/Editing option objects in the option group take in effect immediately.
7.description: This test ensures that option object callback mechanism works and DHCP server doesnt crash and works as expected.
7.result:
The DHCP server doesnt crash. The next DHCP offer send by the server has Tag Number 231 present and not Tag Number 230.
